Projective polarity has exactly 0/1/2 isotropic lines as determined by parity/square class, so N is exact. Zero, one, or two outgoing arrows into that block are characterized by the projected square-line orbit; nonempty exceptional row sets are disjoint across orbits, yielding t+1_{t<N}. Explicit independent-square construction reaches min(n,N). The actual standalone verifier returned VERIFY_OK for 339 consistency checks and exhaustive dimension-three small-prime-field checks. value.rationale: The finite-field exact graph-support spectrum is a complete classification in the minimal nonperfect square-dependence stratum motivated by the 2026 simultaneous graphical realization and natural basis questions. Its sharp min(n,N) value and q=2/q=3 field thresholds distinguish true graph variation from redundant basis changes, and the concrete F5 algebra realizes three pairwise nonisomorphic graphs. This is a graph-realization invariant, not a routine recounting of known bases. The statement does not claim classification of unmarked graphs in general.
